feeds.title: The Association of Fitness Studios Blog
feeds.description: The Association of Fitness Studios (AFS) is a membership organization providing business-specific products, services, and benefits to studio owners. We support your efforts to change more lives by providing you every resource necessary to start, grow or extend the life of your business. Stay connected and better understand what's happening in your segment of the fitness industry.

feeds.description: At Active Fitness Marketing, we help independent gyms and boutique fitness studios to get more quality leads and grow their membership faster. Get maximum exposure for your facility with our proven marketing system and compete with the big box gyms without the big box marketing budget.

feeds.title: Fitness Marketing Mastery Blog
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Debra Atkinson - a full-time fitness professional for 30 years. I've owned a business, managed group fitness and personal training, taught emerging fitness professionals in the university setting and authored articles for industry associations. You're in the right place to get access to tips and resources to help you with growing your business.

Our expert personal trainer website design and marketing services are trusted by hundreds of fitness professionals worldwide.
